title: Lost Lambs
summary: Tam's flock scattered the night he went missing. Bring three sheep back to the pen.

dialogue.intro: Three of Tam's best. They ran when the man with the golden smile came.
dialogue.reward: Tam will sleep tonight. Thank you.
offer: Three of Tam's best. They ran when the man with the golden smile came.
Lead them close. Sheep only trust a full belly.

goals.say: Tam counts them twice and laughs for the first time in a week.
